chronology.notes: Chron based on top and 5 bulk-sediment radiocarbon dates.
Chron based on top and 5 bulk-sediment radiocarbon dates calibrated to cal years with CALIB 4.4. The calibrated ages are the 50% median probabilities.

Chron based on top and estimated age of the top of Artemisia zone. The bulk 14C dates are probably too old, and other evidence indicates a date of .ca 10,000 14C yr BP for top of Artemisia zone (P.T. Davis, pers. comm.).
Chron based on calendar year age for the top of Artemisia zone. See Notes for Chron3.

site.sitedescription: Subalpine lake w/ inlet and outlet streams. Physiography: glaciated mountains. Surrounding vegetation: Pinus albicaulis, Salix, sedges, grasses.
